howItWorks.title: How Does Watch4Trees Work?
howItWorks.subtitle: We combine rewarded ads monetization with certified global reforestation in 3 intuitive steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Open the app during your free moments (commute, coffee break) and pick: a quick 30s spot or a 5-minute focus session.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We exclusively display compliant Rewarded Video formats and purpose-driven brand spots. Eco-Points are accrued for every completed view.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Ad revenue flows directly to verified partners (Posadzimy.pl, One Tree Planted). You receive a certificate and GPS coordinates of the planted parcel.

ideology.title: Why Purpose-First Instead of Click-to-Earn?
ideology.p1: Traditional "watch-to-earn" apps burn user attention for fractions of pennies, generating spam and bot farms.
ideology.p2: Watch4Trees flips this paradigm: You do not earn pocket money for yourself. You invest your most precious currency — attention — into planetary restoration.
ideology.quote: “The driving force is not greed, but moral fulfillment and tangible ecological agency.”
ideology.neg1: Earn fractions of a cent after hours of clicking
ideology.neg2: High risk of fraud bans for fake bot traffic
ideology.neg3: No higher mission, wasted user time
ideology.pos1: 100% of user energy transformed into living forests
ideology.pos3: Public, verifiable payout ledger & GPS certificates
ideology.pos4: A personal virtual forest that thrives with your real impact

gamification.title: A Virtual Forest Living in Reality
gamification.subtitle: Every session nurtures your virtual grove while real-world foresters plant certified trees in the ground.
gamification.f1Desc: Each tree features a unique serial ID, annual CO2 estimate (~22 kg/yr), and a map pin of the reforested land.
gamification.f2Desc: Consistency pays off. Regular sessions 7 days in a row unlock a +30% multiplier to your planting power.
gamification.f3Desc: Schools, cities, and corporate teams compete on the public leaderboard for the title of Top Green Team.
gamification.f4Desc: Unlock achievements for milestones: First Seed, Forest Guardian, Amazon Patron.

transparency.title: Transparency & Revenue Distribution
transparency.desc: We operate with full openness. Users see exactly how ad monetization works and where every single penny is directed.
transparency.foundationDesc: Sapling procurement (oaks, beeches, pines, mangroves), soil preparation, forester wages, and long-term care.
transparency.hostDesc: Cloud hosting (Vercel/Firebase), PostgreSQL database, domains, code maintenance, and direct ad-server operations.

b2b.title: Match-Funding Program & Brand Sponsorship
b2b.desc: Does your company want to achieve ESG/CSR sustainability goals? Sponsor sessions in Watch4Trees and double the trees planted by our community.
b2b.perk1: Dedicated session branding (3-5x higher eCPM and authentic brand recall)
b2b.perk2: Official CO2 offset certificates for annual non-financial ESG corporate reports
b2b.perk3: Direct visibility among conscious, eco-friendly consumers

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.a1: Yes, completely free. Users never pay a penny. Reforestation costs are covered by ethical Rewarded Ads and ESG sponsor match-funding.
faq.q2: How do you prevent ad network account bans (Google AdSense/AdMob)?
faq.a2: We strictly adhere to official Rewarded Video guidelines where users explicitly choose when to watch. We enforce strict frequency capping, SSV (Server-Side Verification), and interactive human attention verification.
faq.q3: Who physically plants the trees and how can I verify it?
faq.a3: We partner exclusively with verified, registered non-profits (Posadzimy.pl, One Tree Planted, Eden Reforestation). Every planting batch yields an official certificate with GPS plot coordinates and photo documentation.
faq.q4: What share of revenue does the platform retain?
faq.a4: The vast majority (85-90%) goes directly to reforestation partners. A transparent minority (10-15%) covers server hosting, database storage, and host infrastructure.
